title: Chapter 105 Mysterious Woman
content:
Chapter 105 Mysterious Woman

This day.

An unprecedented terrifying force suddenly descended from the sky.

It instantly illuminated countless star fields.

Suddenly, countless ancient auras rose from the major star fields.

They looked at the terrifying power in the sky with horror.

"What is that?!"

Many ancient beings looked extremely solemn.

Such power, even they felt deeply desperate.

For a time, countless star fields were shaken, and many masters wanted to deduce the source of this power, but they found nothing.

An extremely brilliant star field.

In a palace full of supreme aura, a beautiful woman suddenly opened her eyes.

She looked up at the terrifying power.

"Immortal?!"

The woman frowned, she couldn't figure it out.

However, when she saw the direction of the power, the woman's face suddenly changed.

"Not good!"

Boom!

In an instant, the terrifying power burst out from the woman's body, and then rushed towards the direction of the Xuanling Star Field.

Xuanling Star Region.

In recent days, many major events have happened in Xuanling Star Region.

The most important point is that the power of Huangcheng, which has never been seen before, suddenly appeared.

It directly swept across the entire Xuanling Star Region.

Even the powerful old sixth force, Jiemeng, was beaten back step by step, and finally under the joint efforts of Shenshan and Huangcheng.

Jiemeng, which had hidden its strength for so long, disappeared in Xuanling Star Region.

Since then, Huangcheng has completely become the new overlord of Xuanling Star Region.

In Huangcheng.

Everyone suddenly stopped what they were doing and looked up at the sky.

"Hey? There is a meteor."

"Hiss~ Why do I feel that there is something wrong with this meteor."

"Fuck, that meteor seems to be coming towards us!"

Suddenly, everyone in Huangcheng began to panic.

In the City Lord's Mansion.

Lu Daosheng looked up at the power with a calm expression.

It is coming after all.

That is a force that does not belong to this world.

At this time, the space beside him suddenly trembled.

The next moment, a familiar voice sounded from Lu Daosheng's ears.

"What did I say? I knew you would offend someone."

The person who came was the guardian of the long river of time and space in this world.

He was extremely angry at this time.

He never thought that Lu Daosheng would provoke such a strong man.

The opponent's attack would probably destroy the entire Xuanling Star Region.

And the long river of time and space he guarded would inevitably be greatly affected.

Facing this attack, he was powerless, and running to Lu Daosheng was just to vent his anger.

However, Lu Daosheng ignored him at all.

"System."

[Yes, host]

"What level is the other party?"

Lu Daosheng asked.

[Seven levels higher than the host's current cultivation]

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

Is this the strong man from the fairy holy land?

Such a strong strength.

Then he doesn't have to worry about anything.

"System, upgrade me ten more levels."

Lu Daosheng decided to upgrade ten more levels, otherwise he would be dead in the face of this strong man who was seven levels higher than him.

However, after hearing the system's answer, Lu Daosheng hesitated again.

[Host, warm reminder, if you upgrade ten levels, the host will not be able to stay in this world and will be forced to ascend]

"Forced to ascend?!"

[Yes, host, this is a rule issue. Here, such a strong man is not allowed to exist. This is why the opponent cannot come in person and can only attack remotely]

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was silent.

"System, I still want to stay here, tell me another way."

This system is so versatile, there must be other ways.

Sure enough, the system said directly:

[There are many ways, one of which is that this system temporarily improves the host's strength and returns to its original state after the crisis is resolved]

Hearing this method, Lu Daosheng nodded slightly.

If the system still has this function, then this method would work.

But,

"System, what if the other party comes again? Wouldn't it be too troublesome?"

[No, if the other party comes here, he will also suffer a great backlash, and the price he pays will also be very high]

"What about other methods?"

[This system forcibly changes the rules of the world, but after changing the rules, the world may be a little messed up]

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

This system is really powerful, making me not know what to say.

"Then temporarily improve my strength."

In the end, Lu Daosheng still chose this method.

He doesn't want to go to a higher level world for the time being. As for the reason, there are very important people here.

And it's not good to mess up the world.

Soon, Lu Daosheng's breath suddenly began to rise rapidly.

A young man who saw this scene was stunned.

He thought Lu Daosheng had given up and was ready to run away first.

Seeing the terrifying aura emanating from Lu Daosheng's body, the young man immediately gasped.

What kind of trick is this?

"You, forget it, you are awesome."

The young man wanted to say something, but in the end he could only say "awesome".

Boom!

At this time, the terrifying power from outside the sky had already arrived at the edge of the Xuanling Star Domain.

In an instant, the entire Xuanling Star Domain began to shatter.

Countless creatures looked at the scene in despair.

This sudden accident never expected none of them.

They are really like ants in front of real strong people.

I don't care about their life and death.

You can destroy it at will.

And it is still a little far away from here in a starry sky.

A woman was rushing towards here with red eyes, her speed was so fast that the void passed by was constantly shattering.

Seeing that the entire Xuanling Star Domain was about to be destroyed, the woman's face suddenly turned ferocious.

"The Holy Land of Fairy Spirit, when I go back, your entire holy land will be destroyed!"

And at this moment, a majestic figure suddenly rose slowly from the Xuanling Star Domain.

People in the world can't see their faces clearly, but they can see where the other person comes from.

The deserted city!

"That's right, the city lord, the city lord!"

In the deserted city, everyone stopped terrified and looked at Lu Daosheng's figure and immediately cheered.

It seems that as long as Lu Dao is alive, there is no danger that can threaten them.

And the fact is, it is indeed the case.

Lu Daosheng looked up at the power rushing towards here, and then punched out.

Boom!

It was accompanied by a deafening roar.

When the two forces collided, the force was immediately destroyed.

Buzz —

At this time, a gentle force enveloped the entire Xuanling Star Domain.

Keep it safe from the aftermath.

For a moment, after a brief silence of the entire Xuanling Star Domain, a crazy shout suddenly came.

"What's that?"

At this time, the woman had arrived at the border of the Qingling Star Domain.

Looking at the huge phantom, the woman felt very familiar for some reason.

At this moment, a sound came from my ears.

"I don't know where this girl comes from?"

Yu Qingfeng smiled and looked at the woman in front of him and spoke.

But I was extremely afraid.

His feelings told him that the other party's strength was extremely terrifying.

The woman glanced at Yu Qingfeng and said indifferently, "You are the one in the Divine Emperor Realm who just broke through here not long ago."

Upon hearing this, Yu Qingfeng nodded and said, "It's exactly what I'm going to do."

The woman turned her head and looked at the void.

A moment later, Jiangbei's figure slowly appeared from it.

"Girl, sorry, people from the outside world are not welcome here for the time being."

Jiangbei opened his mouth.

The task Lu Daosheng gave them to was to stay here and prohibit anyone from entering from outside.

Hearing this, the woman suddenly laughed.

Has he become an outsider if he hasn't come back for so long?

The woman shook her head, her body trembled, and she disappeared directly from the spot.

"this,,"

Looking at the scene in front of him, Yu Qingfeng didn't know what to say.

Jiang Bei was silent for a moment and said slowly: "The other party is very strong, and we can't stop him. Let the city lord solve the problem by himself."

They don’t know whether the other party is an enemy or a friend.

But they know something.

Their city lord is really invincible.

The city lord can take that kind of power that is so terrifying that it is hopeless.

What else in this world is that the city lord cannot solve?
